    body {
      margin: 0 auto;
      max-width: 65ch;
      padding: 1rem;
      font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    input, button, textarea, select { font: inherit; }
    h1, h2, h3 { line-height: 1.2; text-wrap: balance; }
    p { text-wrap: pretty; }
    p, li, h1, h2, h3 { overflow-wrap: break-word; }
    img, svg, video { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
    :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>

I looked at `0.html` and didn't change anything. It's an empty starter page, and the base is already solid: it has the viewport and color-scheme settings, a CSS reset, readable text width, visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support. `<main>` is empty and the title is just "0".

The only small fixes that make sense without knowing its purpose are:
- a real `<title>` and a `<meta name="description">`
- `-webkit-font-smoothing` and `hanging-punctuation` for nicer text
- a `<noscript>` or skip link, if it will have navigation

What should this page be (a landing page, an article, a form, an app shell)? Once I know, I can add the content, layout and styling.
